milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the blast furnace and face toward it, modeling that they can visually observe it up close. The blast furnace is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 10) inside the stone brick building. max_distance=5 ensures the player must enter the building or stand at the entrance looking in (not just face the right direction from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking at the blast furnace.
